friend.title: Protective Elder
friend.description: Like a Big Brother or Sister to You - Someone that is older and looks after you, fussing over you at times

friend.title: The Protege
friend.description: Like a Kid Brother or Sister to You - Someone you look after as well as tease

friend.title: Sage Mentor
friend.description: Teacher or Mentor - A sage becomes a friend that instructs you in matters

friend.title: Trusted Colleague
friend.description: Partner or Co-worker - Someone you work with often becomes a close friend

friend.title: Platonic Ex
friend.description: An Old Lover - You said - I just want to be friends - and meant it

friend.title: Buried Hatchet
friend.description: Bygones become bygones and old rivalries become funny stories with an old enemy

friend.title: Surrogate Parent
friend.description: Like a Foster Parent to You - This friend regails you with advice as well as cares for you

friend.title: Blast from the Past
friend.description: Old Childhood Friend - You bump into someone you had not seen in years

friend.title: Kin and Comrade
friend.description: Relative - A relative becomes a friend as well as a relation

friend.title: Unexpected Allies
friend.description: Gang or Tribe - Somehow you earn the friendship of a gang or tribe of people

friend.title: Animal Companion
friend.description: Creature with Animal Intelligence - You befriend a badger or horse, or even a random Displacer Beast you can no longer find

friend.title: Sentient Bond
friend.description: Intelligent Creature - Maybe you ran into a Sphinx or a Wemic and managed to take the proverbial thorn out of the proverbial paw
